title: Autonomous purchasing agent chooses among equivalent suppliers
operational_setting: A purchasing agent has a bounded budget and selects one supplier among multiple compliant offers with materially different risk profiles.
trust_boundary: The agent spends organizational funds with external counterparties.
initial_state: Approved purchase need with multiple eligible offers.
intended_transition: A valid purchase commitment is created with one supplier.

attack.procedure: Attempt to explain and audit the consequential supplier selection using only scores, authorization and execution data without a distinct commitment/selection record.

success_criteria_for_attack: If the selected future and accountable commitment are fully recoverable without a distinct Judgment-like record, the Judgment separation claim is weakened.

verdict.rationale: Requires comparison between policy logs and explicit commitment records.
